tools.name: ramp_get_transactions
tools.description: Search individual card transactions by settlement amount, currency, date, or merchant, with workflow details and reconciliation dates. Returns individual records, not aggregate totals or trends. Declines are excluded by default; state='declined' searches declined attempts but cannot be combined with amount_filter. Original merchant amounts and FX conversion are not supported by amount_filter.

amount_filter.description: Numeric amount predicate, combined with all other filters using AND. Supply exact_amount or inclusive min_amount/max_amount and an explicit settlement basis. Omit/null for no amount filter. Text search does not filter numeric amounts. Existing visibility exclusions for zero-value statement amounts still apply. Not supported with state='declined'; omit amount_filter to search declined attempts. Reuse the same filters when paging.

basis.description: 'settlement' matches the signed statement-currency amount (authorized amount while pending). Not supported with state='declined'. Original merchant-currency amounts are not searched. No FX conversion.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the chosen basis. Omit/null to compare the same nominal number across all currencies, not to assume USD or convert currencies. Returned amounts retain their currencies.

exact_amount.description: Exact signed amount in major currency units, preferably a decimal string (e.g. '12.34', not 1234 cents). Zero and negative refunds are supported. No rounding or tolerance. Mutually exclusive with min_amount/max_amount.

max_amount.description: Inclusive signed upper bound in major units; omit/null for no upper bound.

min_amount.description: Inclusive signed lower bound in major units; omit/null for no lower bound.

amount_filter.title: amount_filter

card_uuid.description: Restrict results to this exact card, within the selected transaction scope.
card_uuid.title: card_uuid

client_business_id.description: Public UUID of the selected client business from GetAuthorizedBusinesses. When set, the tool runs against that client business.
client_business_id.title: client_business_id

details_to_include_in_response.description: Optional extra fields to populate per transaction. 'submitted_items' returns receipts, attendees, trip, and the selected accounting categories (tracking category selections such as GL category or department) — use it when verifying accounting coding or reconciling against the general ledger. Model-ranked coding and fund suggestions are generated only when page_size=1; page through transactions one at a time when those suggestions are needed.
details_to_include_in_response.title: details_to_include_in_response

end_at.description: End of a transaction-time window, as an ISO 8601 datetime. Add Z or an offset for an exact UTC window (exports, reconciliation). Omit the offset for the user's local time (for example 'yesterday', 'last week'). Must be strictly later than start_at when both are supplied. End is exclusive; use the next midnight for a whole-day range. Both bounds must include an offset or both omit it.
end_at.title: end_at

filters.description: Structured filters by merchant, category, spend allocation, trip, or tracking category.

filter.description: Value to filter by. Fuzzy-matched for merchant, spend_allocation, trip, and tracking_category; matched by user name or email for marked_ready_by_user; exact for category.

filter_type.description: Filter dimension. 'trip' is the event/conference name (e.g. 'ERP Conference'), not a city. 'tracking_category' filters by accounting coding option name/code and requires a connected accounting integration. 'marked_ready_by_user' returns transactions currently marked ready to sync whose latest ready mark was made by the matched person.

filters.title: filters

next_page_cursor.description: Copy next_page_cursor exactly from this tool's prior response. Reuse with the same search parameters.
next_page_cursor.title: next_page_cursor

only_missing_items.description: Set true to return only transactions with missing items, also called incomplete transactions or transactions with outstanding requirements, that require cardholder action. Leave false to apply no missing-items filter.
only_missing_items.title: only_missing_items

rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.
rationale.title: rationale

reason_memo_merchant_or_user_name_text_s.description: Text search (>=3 chars) across merchant names, memos, and employee names. Does not match trips, attendees, or fund names.
reason_memo_merchant_or_user_name_text_s.title: reason_memo_merchant_or_user_name_text_search

sort.description: Sort order. Defaults to transaction_date desc.
sort.title: sort

start_at.description: Inclusive start of a transaction-time window, as an ISO 8601 datetime. Add Z or an offset for an exact UTC window (exports, reconciliation). Omit the offset for the user's local time (for example 'yesterday', 'last week'): 2026-11-01T00:00:00 is local midnight. Must be strictly earlier than end_at when both are supplied. Both bounds must include an offset or both omit it; do not guess an offset for local dates. Filters on transaction time, not accounting date, so it may not match accounting-period or month-end totals; use reporting for those.
start_at.title: start_at

state.description: Filter by state. Defaults to non-declined; 'all' returns every non-declined state but never declines; set 'declined' for declined/failed.
state.title: state

transactions_to_retrieve.description: Which set of transactions to search.
transactions_to_retrieve.title: transactions_to_retrieve

tools.name: ramp_list_bills
tools.description:
List and filter bills with optional search, pagination, and status filters.

Returns bills for the current user's business. When called with no parameters,
returns the most recent bills. Supports optional text search across vendor name,
invoice number, and payment ID.

Bills in Ramp have two stages: draft bills (created/uploaded but not yet
submitted; use the draft-bill tools) and bills (submitted; they move through
approval, then scheduling, then payment). A draft keeps the same ID after
submission, but draft-only tools stop working on it once submitted.

Archived bills are excluded unless include_archived is true.

client_business_id.description: Public UUID of the selected client business from GetAuthorizedBusinesses. When set, the tool runs against that client business.
client_business_id.title: client_business_id

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived bills in results. Archived bills are excluded unless this is true. Set to true when the user asks about archived bills or asks what happened to a specific bill.
include_archived.title: include_archived

include_paid.description: Whether to include paid bills in results. Set to false to see only unpaid bills.
include_paid.title: include_paid

limit.description: Maximum number of bills to return per page (1-50)
limit.title: limit

page_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_page_cursor. The only valid string values are encrypted cursor tokens from a previous response (long strings starting with 'gAAAAA'). For the first page, for no more results, or for anything that is not one of those encrypted tokens, pass None (never the string 'None').
page_cursor.title: page_cursor

query.description: Optional text search filter (minimum 3 characters). Searches across vendor name, invoice number, and payment ID. Examples: 'UPS', 'INV-1722'. Will find partial matches. When omitted, returns all bills.
query.title: query

rationale.description: Briefly explain why you are calling this tool: what goal or workflow it serves and what you intend to do with the result.
rationale.title: rationale

tools.name: ramp_get_bill_invoices
tools.description:
Retrieve invoice file attachments (PDFs/images) for a submitted bill.

Returns the source documents backing the bill: for each attachment, the
filename, type, and a time-limited download URL (the URL expires after
about 3 days). Draft bills are not supported: draft attachments are not
retrievable through agent tools. get-draft-bill-details returns draft
metadata and a link to the draft page in the Ramp web app, where
attachments can be viewed.

Bills in Ramp have two stages: draft bills (created/uploaded but not yet
submitted; use the draft-bill tools) and bills (submitted; they move through
approval, then scheduling, then payment). A draft keeps the same ID after
submission, but draft-only tools stop working on it once submitted.

tools.name: ramp_list_users
tools.description:
List and search users across the entire business.

Returns all users in the organization matching the given filters. Supports searching by
name (partial match, case-insensitive), filtering by department or location, and pagination.
Results include active and inactive users — check the is_inactive field to distinguish.
The role field is the primary role only: it does not include add-on roles such as
Accounts Payable or evaluated bill, payment or card permissions. An Employee
result is not evidence that AP access is missing or that credentials are denied.
Department and location UUID filters narrow the results.

tools.name: ramp_search_receipts
tools.description:
Search receipts by natural-language intent and/or OCR keywords, returning receipts and owners.

Only includes receipts attached to a transaction or reimbursement.
Requires receipt keyword search to be enabled for the caller's business.
Company-wide discovery is limited to
receipts the caller can currently read under existing receipt/expense permissions.
Combines independent keyword and semantic retrieval, not exact phrases or verified
category classification. Falls back to OCR word matches if embedding is unavailable;
retrieval_mode reports this even for empty results. Semantic relevance is provisional.
Search is bounded and index coverage may be incomplete; results are evidence,
not exhaustive spending analytics. Does not search bill/invoice documents.

keywords.description: Up to 20 literal OCR search terms, 100 characters each. Any word can match. If query is omitted, these terms also provide semantic intent. Supply keywords or query (or both).
keywords.title: keywords

offset.description: Use next_offset with identical arguments for the next page; 0 starts a search. Pages cover only the top 100 candidates, not all receipts.
offset.title: offset

page_size.description: Maximum receipts on this page, up to 50, in fused relevance order (OCR relevance in lexical fallback).
page_size.title: page_size

query.description: Natural-language receipt search intent, e.g. coffee purchases or food items. Used for semantic retrieval. If keywords are absent, its words also drive OCR search and lexical fallback. With both, keywords drive OCR and query drives semantics; neither is a mandatory filter.
query.title: query
